decisions.reason: This multi-model box trailer line sits at the core of the firm's announced range and carries substantial sunk investment, and the strong pandemic-era trailer demand makes the missing website visibility in 2020 to 2021 easy to attribute to temporary causes rather than failure.

Heavy tooling and development costs, plus its role in the push toward professional and international customers, give management strong reasons to justify and continue the car transporter line despite its reduced visibility.
The low-bed series was featured publicly as part of the core offering, so the sunk costs and that visible commitment favour keeping it.

Its overlap with line B and its missing visibility make it the most likely candidate for consolidation, but the firm's public commitment and sunk costs still favour gradual merging over outright withdrawal within a year.
